name: garden
description: an overgrown garden where nature has reclaimed what was once carefully manicured. a cracked stone path winds through tangled weeds and brambles. a crumbling fountain stands in the centre, its basin filled with dark, stagnant water. to the north, a rusted wrought-iron gate leads to a graveyard. to the south, the conservatory's glass panels glint. the air is fresh but cold. a single rose bush, impossibly, still blooms — red flowers against the decay.

items.name: fountain
items.description: a stone fountain with a weeping angel statue, its face worn smooth by time and weather. the basin holds dark water, leaves, and a surprising amount of moss. something glints at the bottom.

items.name: silver_crucifix
items.description: a small silver crucifix, tarnished by years underwater. it's still intact. the back is engraved: 'sanctuary — 1889.'

items.name: shovel
items.description: a rusty shovel leaning against a gnarled, ancient oak tree. the blade is caked with dried earth that crumbles when you touch it.

items.name: flowers
items.description: a patch of wilted roses, their petals brown and curling. but one bush defies the decay — a single red rose bush blooms vibrantly, as if it's june instead of october.

items.name: apple_tree
items.description: a small apple tree with a few shriveled but edible apples on the lower branches. the tree looks ancient but stubbornly clings to life.

items.name: garden_bench
items.description: a stone bench under a gnarled oak, overlooking the garden. someone left a thermos here long ago. the oak's roots have grown around the bench's legs.

items.name: thermos
items.description: an old thermos on the bench wedged between the roots. inside: cold but still drinkable tea, though it tastes of oak and earth now.

items.name: oak_tree
items.description: a massive, ancient oak tree, its branches spreading like protective arms over the garden. the bark is gnarled and covered in moss. at eye level, someone has carved a small heart with the initials 'a.b.' and 'm.'

items.name: statue
items.description: a small stone statue of a cherub hidden among the overgrown bushes, its face chipped away. someone deliberately defaced it.

exits.description: a glass-paneled door leading to the garden. the garden beyond looks overgrown but peaceful.
a rusty iron gate covered in climbing ivy. it creaks as it swings.
